{{Quote|Commander Bylsma, something has ''torn a hole'' in Deck eight-five-nine!|Ogden to Commander Bylsma on the Dibrook Space Station|<ref name="IR1" />}}
'''Ogden''' served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] on [[Dibrook Space Station]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bylsma (New Republic)|Bylsma]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Commander Bylsma, that thing is firing - at the enemy!|Ogden to Bylsma during the Battle of Dibrook|<ref name="IR1" />}}
When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Dibrook|attacked]] the Dibrook Space Station and breached [[Deck eight-five-nine]], Ogden alerted his commander and
kept him apprised of the situation while the station's complement of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] fought against the invaders. Shortly after, the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' appeared and started firing on the Yuuzhan Vong ships. Ogden and Bylsma recognized it as friendly, and the commander ordered the fighters to withdraw. After all enemy ships had been defeated, the ''Heart of Artorias'' docked with the damaged station to take on refugees.<ref name="IR1" />

Ogden and four of his [[New Republic soldier/Legends|troops]] were first on the scene to investigate the captured enemy ship, whereupon the captain expressed his compliments on the efforts of the [[Artorias|Artorian]] [[Kaye Galfridian]] and the other former prisoners in taking the vessel. However, when Ogden ordered his troops to take over the bridge so that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] could research it, he was forcibly stopped by [[Arbeloa]], a [[Cilare (species)|Cilare]] former captive of the Yuuzhan Vong and Galfridian's confidant. Kaye thereafter informed Ogden that the ship would only serve as a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] vessel. The captain was released by Arbeloa after he ordered the troops to stand down.<ref name="IR1" />

Shortly after, Galfridian met Ogden's superior, Bylsma, and asked him for help rescuing people that the Yuuzhan Vong had taken to the surface of [[Dibrook]] during the battle. Ogden was opposed to the idea, but Bylsma ordered him to accompany Kaye on the [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|mission]], accompanied by the station's contingent of troops. After they had touched down on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Ogden attempted to take control of the mission and implement overly aggressive tactics; on Kaye Galfridian's orders, the captain was bound and restrained by Arbeloa. Galfridian remarked afterwards that Ogden's battle plan would have led to unnecessary casualties.<ref name="IR2" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He is a fool and would've gotten people killed.|Kaye Galfridian speaking of Ogden on Dibrook, shortly after the captain's exclusion from the mission|<ref name="IR2" />|}}
Ogden was a hot-headed individual, who would openly criticize others' decisions. Despite his rank, he would take a hasty, less effective course of action if he saw fit, and would thus endanger people under his command. His antagonistic nature would be his undoing on Dibrook, where Kaye Galfridian would order Ogden off the mission due to his arguments against a preferable approach.
